Rajnath Singh links Independence to incomplete cultural renaissance

Defence Minister Rajnath Singh stated that India's cultural and civilisational renaissance remained incomplete after Independence. He also called for an integrated civil-military aerospace ecosystem and the development of indigenous technologies. Singh made these remarks in separate statements, with one focusing on the post-Independence cultural gap and another on bolstering India's aerospace capabilities.
